basic_info.description: A truly elegant residence in the heart of San Francisco, this 1-BR, 1-BA condo has a beautifully updated bathroom, newer wood flooring and new recessed lights. The kitchen has all new stainless appliances. The Complex offers an array of unparalleled amenities, including a 24-hour heated pool and spa, a state-of-the-art gym, racquetball court and sauna providing the ultimate in relaxation and recreation. The high-service HOA ensures a worry-free lifestyle with 24-hour security personnel, on-site management, concierge services, and the convenience of laundry facilities within the building. Additionally, the HOA fee includes Water, Trash, High-speed Internet, building maintenance, and Earthquake insurance. A perfect retreat for discerning individuals seeking an upscale urban sanctuary.
